C. I. D.
E. C. REG
Shanghai Municipal Police.    No. 229
Date 10/4/16

Bubbling Well    Station.
April 10th    1916

REPORT ON Arrival of troops in Shanghai

Made by D. S. Sullivan.    Forwarded by

Sir
I respectfully beg to report that during
the morning of the 9th inst. 2000 soldiers with
15 horses arrived at Jessfield and proceeded to
the camp at Longhwa. The men all had their
rifles with them. They came from Peking and
left the train at Tsung S. doing the remaining
10 li on foot.
On the night of the 8th 70 soldiers
and mules arrived at Jessfield and went to
Longhwa.
I beg to remain
Sir
Your Obedient Servant
J. Sullivan. Det Sgt.

10/4
The Chief Detective Inspector.

东区登记处
上海公共租界工部局警务处。    第 229 号
日期 1916 年 4 月 10 日

静安寺捕房。
1916 年 4 月 10 日

关于部队抵达上海的报告

由 D. S. Sullivan 呈报。    转呈

阁下
谨此报告，本月 9 日上午，2000 名士兵携
15 匹马抵达极司菲尔（Jessfield），随后前
往龙华营地。所有士兵均随身携带步枪。他
们来自北京，在宋家宅（Tsung S.）下车，步
行完成剩余 10 里路程。
8 日晚，70 名士兵及骡马抵
达极司菲尔（Jessfield），并前往
龙华。
卑职
谨上
J. Sullivan，侦探警长

4 月 10 日
首席侦探督察
